evidence_sources.insight: The architecture limits the product to inbound request qualification, estimator assignment, site evidence, scope notes, customer visibility, and an explicit quote-ready decision. It explicitly avoids replacing accounting or dispatch.

Jobber's page, updated July 10, 2026, documents requests arriving through websites, client portals, phone calls, email, and in-person conversations. Its intake forms can collect job information, photos, and measurements, then lead to follow-up, an on-site assessment, a quote, or a job.

Google Local Services documents inbound call and message leads. Message leads include the customer's name, ZIP code, job details, and phone number, and Google exposes response-time estimates after enough message leads.
Housecall Pro presents the broad field-service alternative as a suite spanning calls, scheduling, pipeline, estimating, dispatch, invoicing, payments, customer management, and accounting integration.

positioning.buying_trigger: The owner or office coordinator is re-entering estimate requests from calls, messages, email, and forms, then chasing missing site details before an estimator can act.
positioning.category: Quote-intake and site-visit coordination software for small residential service contractors
differentiators: A narrow intake-to-quote-ready workflow that complements, rather than replaces, accounting and dispatch systems.
An explicit quote-ready decision tied to site details, photos, measurements, scope notes, and an accountable estimator.
A customer-visible request package that keeps the source request and later field evidence connected before quoting.
positioning.ideal_customer: The office coordinator or owner who qualifies incoming work and schedules estimators without replacing the company's accounting or dispatch system
positioning.job_to_be_done: Turn each inbound service request into a complete, assigned, customer-visible quote package with site details, photos, scope notes, and an explicit quote-ready decision
objections: We already use field-service software, spreadsheets, email, and text messages; another system may create duplicate entry.
Our request types need different questions, photos, measurements, and site-visit rules; a generic form may not capture enough detail.
Customers may still call or text, so an online form alone will not create one reliable queue.
A quote-ready label is not useful unless the estimator trusts the evidence and can see who made the decision.
positioning.primary_alternative: Keep calls, texts, email, and web-form submissions in their existing channels, then coordinate qualification and estimator handoff through memory, notes, spreadsheets, or the intake features of a full field-service platform.
positioning.value_proposition: Give a small residential service contractor one focused path from scattered estimate request to an assigned, evidence-backed quote-ready package, while leaving accounting and dispatch in the systems the company already uses.

sections.body: Receiving a request does not promise a visit, quote, schedule, price, or acceptance. The next step stays visible with its accountable owner.
